title: Sass — Final Knowledge and Portfolio Assessment

recommended_settings.attempts: Follow the current CodeLeaf exam policy; this blueprint does not alter live attempt limits.

assessment_type: Mixed single-choice knowledge questions, practical Sass exercises, and a human-reviewed capstone project.
outcomes: Explain Sass compilation and the distinction between source-time and browser-time behavior.
Use modern Sass syntax, values, built-in modules, control flow, mixins, and functions.
Design maintainable module boundaries and reusable token/component APIs.
Validate the generated CSS, responsive behavior, accessibility, and output size.
Modernize legacy Sass patterns with reviewable migration and regression checks.

topic_distribution.topic: Control Flow and Programmatic CSS Generation
Sass Partials and the Modern Module System
Responsive Design, Themes, and Modern CSS
Sass CLI, Build Tools, and Integration

question_file_strategy: Each lesson has a separate three-question draft knowledge-check set. The final exam question bank is a separate file under exams/final-exam-questions.json. Question answer keys are repository-side and must be filtered from learner-facing API responses.
practical_assessment: The final portfolio/capstone requires a documented, compilable Sass design system with module API, tokens, themes, accessibility and CSS-output evidence. Human review is required; the current CodeLeaf playground does not compile Sass.
remediation_policy: Use missed outcomes to recommend lesson review and practice. Publish only after technical accuracy, question clarity, compiled examples, grading, accessibility, and API answer filtering are reviewed.
